title: House Model Canvas Schema
description: Schematic layout of a building's rooms for deterministic CAD rendering. All values are synthetic or derived from the source registry. No real topology or measurements are embedded in this schema — actual data lives in per-instance fixture files that must be independently generated.

room_id.description: Synthetic identifier, e.g. RM-001, SYN-ROOM-A. Never derived from a real room name.

name.description: Human-readable label. Null-safe: renderer shows 'UNNAMED' when null or absent.

linear_dims_mm.description: Measured or area-derived dimensions in millimetres.

corroborated_area_m2.description: Area in square metres when width/depth are unavailable. Used to render a nominal placeholder, not a measurement.

unresolved_conflicts.description: Conflicts that the renderer displays but does not resolve.

openings.description: Measured openings (windows, doors) recorded by the source registry but not placed on geometry in this schematic renderer.

openings_not_placed.description: True when openings have measurements but no wall coordinates.
